text:
maria: Standup — what I did: rotated 12 nodes in eu-west-1 and ran the nightly warmup, investigated elevated 95p latency around 03:20 UTC. blockers: spot evictions caused shard imbalance in ap-northeast-1; quota bump for APAC still pending (ticket Q-1892). today: will open PR for routing fallback + coordinate with SRE to prewarm pools. @devin can you confirm if the extra 2 GPUs are available? :wave:
devin: saw the evictions in the logs — ~15% spot churn at ~03:30UTC. I filed a tentative quota request (Q-1892) and started a resource scan. There are 2 spare prewarmed nodes in eu-west-2 but they are mixed instance types. Quick CLI check: `infractl fleet status --region ap-northeast-1 --filter spot`
sam: reviewing maria's PR (PR #542) — left one comment about kv-cache TTL and a test flake. plan to LGTM after CI. also bumped autoscaler min from 6->8 for the ap-northeast test cluster to reduce churn during peak.
iris: blocker: finance needs justification for reserved capacity in APAC before approving >$6k/mo. can someone share perf & cost deltas for the quantized vs full model? cc @maria
devin: I can export a quick delta today. rough numbers: quantized profile saves ~35% token compute cost and increases GPU throughput by ~1.2x; will attach a spreadsheet to Q-1892 by EOD.
bot-provision: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `redwood-runtime:v1.12` in eu-west-1. Rolling 4/20 nodes. details: https://deploys/redwood/12345
maria: ack deploy-bot :thumbsup: i'll monitor dashboards — if 95p > 600ms we revert. requesting SRE handoff at 14:00 UTC for the canary window.
sam: tiny FYI — saw repeated logs: `OOM while allocating KV cache` on gpu-az2-17 during the warmup loop. added to INC-3345. may be related to the new kv-cache settings in PR #542.
iris: +1 on the cost numbers. devex also asked for a small example script showing region fallback behavior for customers; i'll take that on and mock responses.
devin: for prewarm infra, recommend `infractl prewarm --region ap-northeast-1 --count 2 --allow-mixed-instance-types` to avoid long wait on exact types.
maria: thanks all — closing my blockers for today. i'll ping here once quota is approved or if the canary crosses thresholds. :rocket:
